meta.title: Debt Consolidation Doesn't Erase What You Owe. Here's What It Actually Does.
meta.hook: Debt consolidation can lower one payment while quietly increasing the total amount you pay.
meta.description: A debt consolidation loan combines several debts, like credit cards, into one new loan with one payment. If the new rate is lower than your old average rate, it can genuinely cut what you pay in interest. But the total amount owed doesn't shrink the moment you sign, and it can grow again if old cards get used again. Educational content only, not financial advice.
